items.name: Files, inodes and file system metadata
items.explanation: On a Unix-like file system every file has an inode, a record of information about the file such as its size and ownership.

assumedBy.quote: requires at least one inode, which is hundreds of bytes

items.name: Quorum and consensus protocols
items.explanation: Machines agree on one answer by voting, so a majority decides even if some fail. It is powerful but hard to build correctly.

assumedBy.quote: MP eschews quorum-style consensus or distributed coordination as much as possible
